file_roles.evidence: The UTF-8 BOM skip was inside #if QT_CONFIG(textcodec), so qmake (no textcodec) never skipped it; diff moves the detection out and always sets dataPos = 3.

rationale: qmake is built without textcodec, so the BOM bytes stayed in the first line and the [Paths] section was not parsed. readIniFile now skips the BOM in all builds. The faulty conditional was in this function.
